snippet.title: Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue - Official Release Date Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue, a horse-riding adventure game developed by PikPok. Players will rescue horses to put their riding skills to the test. Customize styles and uncover all to see in Moonrise Valley in Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue, launching on June 16 for iOS and Android with the game coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and PC (Steam) in 2027.
